steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Total. Each line is added up and must link to a plan item with an owner and a currency.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 line is over the 20 percent limit

findings.title: Line more than 20 percent above last year with no reason
findings.fix: Give the reason or reduce the line

findings.title: Line with no link to a plan item
findings.fix: Link the line to the plan

outcome.notChecked: Whether the budget is affordable at group level.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

pros: Checks a line with no owner or no link to a plan item; a line more than 20 percent above last year's actual with no reason; a missing currency or period.
cons: Not checked: Whether the budget is affordable at group level.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mkt-budget skill on the records for this review.
